details:
Hello, nice to meet you.

I really enjoy communicating using the item and emoji features, and because of that, I purchase every bundle. Recently, however, there are two issues that have been bothering me, and I’d like to share some requests with the developers.

First, even though the number of items keeps increasing, there is still only one item wheel available. In contrast, emojis and stickers can be configured up to Custom 3, allowing up to 27 slots.

Because of this limitation, any items beyond the first 9 cannot be accessed instantly, and I have to open the inventory each time, which is very inconvenient.

I would really appreciate it if items could be saved and accessed more easily, similar to emojis and stickers.

Second, could the cooldown restriction for bundle emojis be relaxed to a level similar to the default emojis?

Default emojis have short cooldowns and can be used even while effects are still playing. In comparison, bundle emojis require waiting several additional seconds after the effect has completely ended before another emoji can be used, which makes them very difficult to use.

This is especially noticeable with recent emojis that have extremely long effect durations (for example, the Sky Lantern added yesterday lasts for about a minute 😅). Not being able to use anything else until the effect finishes feels very frustrating.

I understand that these restrictions may be intended to prevent spam or disruptive behavior from players repeatedly using flashy emojis, but I feel the current limitations are excessive.
title: Increase Item Slots and Reduce Cooldown for Bundle Emojis
